name: Audio Flamingo: A Novel Audio Language Model with Few-Shot Learning and Dialogue Abilities
problem: Existing audio LMs could not combine broad audio understanding with in-context learning and multi-turn dialogue.
mechanism: Builds on a frozen/fine-tuned Flamingo-style Perceiver-resampler architecture bridging audio encoders to an LLM, plus training techniques and data strategies targeting in-context learning and multi-turn dialogue. Audio is again compressed to a fixed token budget by the resampler.
notes:
ICML 2024 per the arXiv comment. The successor line (Audio Flamingo 3, 2507.08128; Audio Flamingo Next, 2604.10905) extends this work; none of these are in production serving stacks. Consistent with the speech-LM cluster: no paper in this family reports a hardware-level latency or throughput measurement, which is itself a signal that the speech-LM literature is optimising for capability demos rather than serving economics.
